from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """One financial metric extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name in this document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/financial code if present")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The line-item name, e.g. '一年内到期的非流动负债'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount as a number")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="The statement type, e.g. '合并资产负债表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
